name: molly-guide help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:molly-guide. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Close the walkthrough
entries.text: Closes the walkthrough. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: What do you want to do
entries.text: Where you set “What do you want to do”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Stop talking
entries.text: Stops talking. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Show me the sample
entries.text: Turns “Show me the sample” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Read each step out loud
entries.text: Where you set “Read each step out loud”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Move the console to each step (run its action)
entries.text: Where you set “Move the console to each step (run its action)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Open walkthroughs Molly makes from AmberX by themselves
entries.text: Where you set “Open walkthroughs Molly makes from AmberX by themselves”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Molly guide
entries.text: Shows the “Molly guide” part of this screen. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Ask Molly to show me
entries.text: Asks molly to show me. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Replay the last walkthrough
entries.text: Replays the last walkthrough. Part of Molly guide.

entries.title: Re-record the AmberX walkthrough
entries.text: Shows “Re-record the AmberX walkthrough”. Part of Molly guide.
